nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Ultra Facial Oil-Free Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including severe or T-zone-focused oiliness, most often report reduced shine and fewer breakouts without the tight, stripped feeling they got from other oil-control cleansers, though a few say it strips skin like older harsh formulas.
segments.dry: The few reviewers who describe dry skin mostly report the product made their skin feel drier or tight, with one warning it's better suited to summer use than winter.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin (oily T-zone, dry cheeks/temples) frequently say this cleanser balances both areas at once without over-drying one side or leaving the other oily.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report no breakouts or irritation and good tolerance, though one reviewer traced a rosacea-like rash to a reformulation that added salicylic acid.
segments.mature: A small number of older or mature-skin reviewers report improved pore appearance and a fresher, more youthful-looking complexion.

concerns.aging: A couple of mature-skin reviewers say their skin looks and feels younger or that pores appear smaller after regular use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not leave skin dry or tight, but a notable minority (including one 2-star and one 5-star sample review) report it left their skin feeling dry, tight, or waxy, particularly in winter.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with acne-prone, red, oily skin and psoriasis reports the cleanser did not add to her redness; another linked a rosacea-type rash to a reformulated version containing salicylic acid.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers highlight that it cleans without stripping natural oils or damaging the skin's balance, though a few describe a waxy residue or stripped, tight feeling that suggests barrier discomfort for them.
concerns.spots: Numerous reviewers report a reduction in blackheads and clearer pores within one to several weeks; one reviewer estimated a 65% improvement in blackheads within days.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts or better-controlled acne over weeks to months of use, but one reviewer specifically describes ongoing cystic/nodular breakouts in summer despite improvement, and another (3-star) says it did not handle oily/acne skin as well as expected.
concerns.oiliness: The large majority of reviewers with oily skin report visibly less shine and better oil control without over-drying, though one 1-star and one 3-star reviewer felt it stripped oil too harshly or underperformed relative to expectations.

aspects.libelle: Waxy or filmy residue after rinsing

extraits.texte: I have really oily skin. This cleanser makes my face feel exactly like those old cleansers that would completely strip your skin of any traces of oil. It leaves my skin feeling uncomfortable… The OG is the way to go.

extraits.titre: This wash now has Salicylic Acid!
extraits.texte: This was a staple skin care product for me, but for the past 4 months Ive been dealing with an odd rash around my nose/lips, when to my doc, possible rosacea, doc said to double check my products as well, and long behold.. this wash NOW HAS SALICYLIC ACID. THIS DID NOT BEFORE so beware! I have very sensitive skin, I stopped using this product (2 wks after) and my rash now went away. It'd would've been nice to share that you added a new ingredient... especially one that can dry skin out. I'll missed this wash :-(

extraits.titre: superb facial cleanser for sensitive combination skin wit...
extraits.texte: Ultra Facial Oil Free Cleanser truly cleans your face without over drying like many oil free cleansers. I have very sensitive combination skin with very oily t-zone and dry every where else. I struggle with mild adult acne, blackheads/whiteheads on my nose & cheeks. Finding the right cleanser that won't irritate/break me out, won't make me oily or won't dry out my skin has been super challenging. This one is the winner. Within 2 days I noticed how clear & clean my face looks. After using the cleanser, I can see all the dirt stuck in my enlarge pores purging out. My skin has improved in 2 days! Also, tiny amount goes a long way. It's lathers quickly. I use the Ultra Facial Oil Free Toner & Moisturizer as well. The toner gives it an extra cleaning, it's calming & moisturizing. The Moisturizer is light, refreshing, and my face feels dewy & moisturized. LOVE!

extraits.titre: Please read if the list below resonate with you
extraits.texte: Key words/issues: •combination skin •very oily skin in summer •hormonal breakouts •large pores •blackheads •nothing else is working After constantly switching cleansers because nothing combated my breakouts, I was determined to find the "perfect" cleanser for my skin. I have tried everything from luxury to drug store cleansers: Kate Somerville, Dermalogica, Murad, Cetaphil, Mario Badescu, and Clean and Clear. Nothing worked as good as Kiehls cleanser. I have combination skin that is very oily in the summer and dry patches in the winter. The cleanser can feel like it is stripping your skin but if you have large pores, blackheads, and hormonal breakouts, it is worth it to combat the issues. My pores feel "cleaned" out. I have been using it for 4 weeks and my skin became more clear every day I used it. I no longer have weekly breakouts. I follow the cleanser with Clinique moisturizer and I only use the cleanser once a day. I recommend this product if you have any of the following issues listed above.

extraits.titre: Worth a try for oily skin
extraits.texte: I have OILY skin in the summer, and pretty normal skin the rest of the year. I have used this for about 2 weeks now and it has made quite the difference in my ACNE PRONE, OILY skin. During the summer, I go from an occasional break out to a severe case of moderate acne--lots of whiteheads and a handful of nodules (the big painful ones that appear under your skin). I used this twice a day (morning and night) and it has done its part to control the acne and treat it. TBH, I am thoroughly surprised it did as much as it does. I am going to keep using this for the summer and probably switch it out for the fall, but come back for it once the temperatures increase again. My general routine with this product: Cleanse Occasional exfoliator Toner Serum Moisturizer

I also received this product as a sample and have now purchased the full size. Small amount needed to lather whole face and I can use it to take my makeup off as well. I have a lot of trouble finding facial products because of my acne prone, red, oily skin and I also struggle with psoriasis. This cleanser is one of the only products I've found to clean my face well, not cause a breakout, and also not add to my redness. It is great.

This cleanser is amazing for normal to oily skin type. So for the 1 star below, know your skin type! This is not for sensitive or dry skin. Amazing product, only need a pea size amount so this size lasted me an entire year using twice a day. That is very rare to find.
